title: Riemannian manifolds with convex boundary
summary: Boundary geometry of smooth Riemannian manifolds with boundary over Mathlib's half-space model: boundary defining functions, the second fundamental form, Weingarten map and mean curvature, conformal change, strict convexity/convexity/strict concavity with Hessian characterisations and stability, regular domains and the realisation of every (M, g) in a boundaryless manifold (defining functions on GeometricTopology's collar extension and double, Seeley extension of metrics), geodesics at the boundary, signed distance and boundary normal coordinates, convexity functions with strictly concave level sets, unit sphere bundle strata, exit time and its regularity, non-trapping criteria (Paternain–Salo–Uhlmann Prop. 3.3.1), scattering relation and lens data, and acceptance examples (balls, caps, hyperbolic domains, small geodesic balls, half-spaces, exteriors, a conformal disc made strictly concave).
